versions.changelog:
alibabacloud-maxcompute-migration-service v0.0.2

- Refactored and tightened core SKILL.md description, emphasizing clear workflow boundaries, session tracking, and safety rules.
- Split command references into dedicated files (datasource, job/timer/task, mapping/planning), and added managed migration and openAPI checklist docs.
- Enforced stricter `source_id` resolution and mandatory confirmation before creating migration jobs.
- Updated and expanded CLI/environment setup guidance; minimum required aliyun CLI version is now 3.3.3.
- Reorganized references; removed obsolete skill-card.md and merged related command reference files.
- Introduced session-level user-agent for observability and tracing across all CLI/API calls.

Initial release of alibabacloud-maxcompute-migration-service skill.

- Enables management of Alibaba Cloud MaxCompute Migration Service (MMS) for migrating data from Hive, BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, Redshift, and MaxCompute to MaxCompute.
- Guides users through the entire migration workflow, including pre-checks, job/task management, and data source resolution.
- Enforces security best practices by sanitizing sensitive credentials in all API responses before any display or file operations.
- Clarifies key MMS concepts (Migration Job vs Task), and proactively prompts users when intent is ambiguous.
- Includes exact CLI usage notes, prerequisites, and troubleshooting steps for smooth migration operations.
